content: {"phoneNote":"The sticky header overlaps the hero photo and body text in the full-page capture (header sits mid-page over the image, hiding the headline), and the fixed bar's „Navodila za pot“ label is clipped at the right edge.","desktopNote":"The sticky header drifts down and sits over the headline „ga boste zapomnili“ in the full-page capture, and the hero leaves a large dead band below the photo before the pricing section.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Make the header static or ensure it never covers the hero headline and photo; on phone also give the fixed bar room so „Navodila za pot“ isn't cut off.","Tighten vertical rhythm on desktop: cut the empty band under the hero and the gaps around the services and footer wordmark; let the bridal photo also appear higher.","Reduce the duplicated call actions (header „Pokličite“, hero „Pokličite me“, CTA band „Pokličite me“) to one primary styled button per screen, and give the hero links real button weight."],"blockers":["Phone: fixed header bar clips the „Navodila za pot“ label at the right edge.","Phone: sticky header overlaps the hero photo and hides the headline in the full-page view.","Desktop: sticky header overlaps the hero headline „ga boste zapomnili“ in the full-page view."]}
